title: Fluxid Workflow Report
description: Report file structure for workflow phase outcomes (implement or review). Written by external agents, read by fluxid workflow controller.

examples: fluxid implement
fluxid review
internal/storage/report.go
e2e-tests/tests/report_validation_test.go

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when report was generated

status.description: Outcome of workflow phase. PASS exits loop, FAIL triggers retry with history context.

blockers.description: Critical issues preventing progress (must be resolved before PASS)
examples: Test TestValidateReport_InvalidStatus failing
Missing required dependency: github.com/xeipuuv/gojsonschema

defects.description: Bugs or incorrect behavior (should be fixed but may not block PASS)
examples: Validation doesn't check for YAML anchors/aliases
Error messages missing field paths for nested failures

concerns.description: Potential problems requiring attention (may become blockers)
examples: File validation error messages could be more specific
No test coverage for 10MB file size limit edge case

observations.description: Notable findings that are not problems (informational)
examples: Used xeipuuv/gojsonschema for JSON Schema validation
Constitution check verified sequential workflow compliance

enhancements.description: Improvement suggestions for future iterations (optional optimizations)
examples: Consider adding schema caching for performance
Could batch validate multiple files in single command
Run E2E tests to verify integration
Update documentation with new commands
Remove deprecated IPC package files
